story.title: Medical research and technology transfer

scenes.headline: Indian health research is moving beyond the lab.
scenes.narration: A quiet milestone in Indian healthcare: more research is being licensed for practical development.

scenes.headline: From discovery toward products
scenes.note: Not the same as approved products
scenes.narration: The Indian Council of Medical Research reported one hundred cumulative technology transfer deals.

scenes.headline: New licensing agreements
scenes.subhead: Covering eight technologies and nine Indian companies
scenes.narration: Twenty licensing agreements at a November summit covered eight technologies and nine Indian companies.

scenes.headline: How research moves ahead
scenes.subhead: A license does not guarantee regulatory approval.
scenes.narration: Licensing can help a company develop research into a product. That is not the same as regulatory approval or commercial success.

scenes.headline: Ideas worth following
scenes.subhead: At the ICMR health innovation summit
scenes.note: Showcased does not mean commercially available.
scenes.narration: Seventeen indigenous health technologies were showcased, revealing a promising development pipeline.

scenes.headline: The lab is only step one.
scenes.subhead: Bridging research to real-world use matters.
scenes.narration: The bigger story is building the bridge between Indian research laboratories and practical healthcare innovation.
